# zinn_domains (Data Source)

Every domain in the API key's organisation. Use a domain's `id` as `domain_id` on `zinn_dns_record`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zinn_domains" "all" {}

locals {
  example_com = one([for d in data.zinn_domains.all.domains : d if d.fqdn == "example.com"])
}
```

- `id` (String) Domain id.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Nameservers.
- `ownership_mode` (String) How the domain is held.
- `status` (String) Status.
